nodes.name: population_strategy.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive operational guide defining how to populate the dev_graph ontology: creation principles, trigger conditions, phased population roadmap, module/file/test node templates, and an end-of-session writeback checklist for all engineering sessions.
nodes.languageNotes: At 1162 lines, this is the primary governance manual for dev_graph population — covering all 24 node types, 11 lint checks, and a full phase-by-phase creation sequence. It supersedes earlier population strategy drafts.

nodes.name: project_structure.md
nodes.summary: Directory listing and structural snapshot of the layer_3_wiki repository (an Obsidian vault), documenting the wiki, raw, and .claude directories with their file contents at a point in time.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Python project configuration for the layer3-trading-engine package, declaring Hatchling as the build backend, packaging the seven src/ sub-packages (risk, supervisor, snapshot, features, regime, gold, execution), and configuring pytest, mypy strict mode, and ruff linting.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PEP 517/518 [build-system] table with Hatchling; strict mypy is enabled over src/ with python_version 3.10. Optional dev dependencies include pytest>=8, mypy>=1.8, and ruff>=0.6.

nodes.name: slice2 fit assessment and roadmap.md
nodes.summary: Post-audit assessment of Slice 2 (the paper-trading admission layer) against the evolutionary plan, covering fit validation across 6 plan points, a prioritized forward roadmap (R1–R5), the La Niña intraday gold design, and a backtesting/evidence-collection framework.
nodes.languageNotes: 26 sections dated 2026-06-10, based on PAPER_TRADING_RUNTIME_FINAL_AUDIT.md (97/100 score). Identifies DEBT-01 (snapshot publisher NameError) as the critical-path blocker for corpus accumulation.

nodes.name: the-gold-decisionpacket-v0-glowing-meerkat.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan (Epoch a) for the paper-trading runtime stateful admission layer: defines the RuntimeDecisionRecord wrapping pattern, pure-core evaluate() function contract, two-slice delivery (ADR-009 governance then code freeze), guard taxonomy, ledger design, and Alpaca paper-trading integration.
nodes.languageNotes: 8 sections covering ADR-first governance, offline simulator vs Alpaca paper backend duality, gold→GLD instrument mapping, EOD cadence alignment, and strategy isolation via separate paper accounts.

nodes.name: ultimateplan.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive evolutionary architecture plan for the El Nino / Alpaca paper-trading system, written in Hungarian, covering the full Alpaca integration design: layer model placement, gold-to-GLD instrument mapping, paper-only configuration constraints, DecisionPacket-to-order mapping, dual execution backend design, and the learning feedback loop.
nodes.languageNotes: Document body is written in Hungarian, describing the Alpaca integration layer (Layer 4 Execution Infrastructure). Covers hard gates (LIVE_ENABLED=false), paper base URL enforcement, dual backend (offline sim + Alpaca paper), and strategy isolation via separate paper accounts.
